correctness.rationale: The basis-by-basis determinant derivation is correct, but the final set-level invariant uses the wrong extremization. The cited primary definition is D(E)=inf over exponential bases of |det T(E,B)|, whereas the proof maximizes over k. Since every nonzero k occurs, the correct infimum is 2 m^(m/2) sin(pi/m), not the displayed maximum-chord formulas. For m=4 the spectrum has minimum 16 sqrt(2) and maximum 32, while the package claims 32 for D(E_4). The headline exact D(E_m) statement is therefore false.
